markdown_content: ## Clo 2024.2 Features Highlights This document details the new features and improvements introduced in the Clo 2024.2 release, covering updates to the library window, user interface customization, modular block management, pattern editing tools, grading enhancements, fabric creation, avatar customization, simulation performance, rendering optimization, and export options. Technical terms such as modular blocks, grainline, grade groups, POM (Points and Measure) object browser, GPU simulation, and panoramic exports are explained alongside procedural instructions and key functionality improvements. --- ## New Library Window and Asset Management This section covers the introduction of a new beta library window in Clo 2024.2, enhanced asset access, and integration with the Clove ecosystem for garment and workspace management. - A new beta library window is accessible via the current library window. - All Clove-provided assets are available, plus additional assets for user projects. - Viewing options from the previous library are retained and expanded. - Easy switching between Clove and Connect assets with a single toggle button. - Faster and more direct connection to Cloveset, allowing access to company rooms, workrooms, and garments. - Users can create their own custom Clovers (personalized assets or libraries). --- ## User Interface Customization: Color Modes This section explains the new light and dark color modes for the Clo interface, enhancing user comfort and workflow personalization. - Two color modes are available: Light Mode and Dark Mode. - Access these settings under User > Interface > Appearance. - Changing color mode requires restarting the software. - Provides a seamless working experience in the chosen color mode. --- ## Modular Blocks: Sewing Line Control and Workflow Safeguards Details improvements in modular block management, sewing line precision, and workflow safeguards to prevent style mismatches. - Under User Settings > Other > Modular Library: - **Notch Sewing**: When enabled, sewing lines follow pattern notches instead of segments, aiding pleated or gathered garment construction. - **Prevent Mix and Match**: Optional safeguard that alerts users when switching between different style blocks that may not fit properly in the 3D window. - Users receive a warning and can choose to override or accept the guidance. --- ## Pattern Editing Enhancements: Convert to Point, Unlinking Baselines, Change Length, and Replace Pattern This section outlines tools improving pattern editing efficiency and flexibility. - **Convert to Point**: - Right-click options to convert points to curves or segments. - Options include converting a single point or maintaining curve integrity by creating multiple curve points. - **Unlink Internal and Baseline Shapes**: - Allows asymmetrical editing by unlinking internal and baseliner shapes on individual pattern pieces, useful for tags or liners. - **Change Length**: - Enables selection of multiple segments simultaneously for batch length adjustment. - **Replace Pattern**: - Allows replacing a pattern piece with one from another garment, regardless of differing numbers of segment points. - User specifies anchor points; Clo recalculates the pattern. - Sewing, fabric, and internal line data are preserved. - Simulation is required after replacement to finalize. --- ## Grainline Improvements and Safeguards This section describes enhanced grainline management with industry-standard options and safeguards. - Users can input grainline degree or direction numerically. - Grainline can be linked or unlinked across colorways. - Orientation options include 1-way, 2-way, or 4-way grainline. - Grainline blocking options provide safeguards to prevent misuse during garment construction. --- ## Grade Groups and OBJ Trim Grading Details expanded grading capabilities, including grading of trims and improved grade size insertion. - New ability to add graded sizes above an existing graded size: - Full smaller grade size or half size can be added automatically. - OBJ trims and button trims can now be graded using pattern grading tools. - Important: trims must be glued to the pattern before grading. - Introduction of pressure fitmaps in Grade Review: - Allows visualization of strain, stress, and pressure across graded sizes side by side. - Supports arranging graded sizes in any layout. --- ## POM Object Browser Organization and Graded Size Visibility This section covers new organizational features for Points and Measure (POM) objects. - Users can create folders to organize POMs within the browser. - Folder structure is preserved when exporting POM data to CSV files. - Ability to show or hide graded sizes within the POM browser via an eye icon. - Drag-and-drop functionality simplifies exporting POMs to CSV. --- ## Nesting Algorithm and Colorway Linking Explains improvements to nesting speed, accuracy, and colorway-specific nesting control. - Nesting algorithm speed and accuracy have significantly increased. - Users can select which colorways follow nesting settings: - Options include "Print All" or "Custom" selection of colorways. - New grouping option for graded sizes organizes them into grouped areas along the marker while optimizing layout efficiency. --- ## Avatar Editor: Breast Shape Control and Mesh Size Adjustment Discusses avatar customization features including breast shape controls and mesh refinement for collision management. - Breast shape controls include three parameters: - **Shape**: Round or teardrop breast shapes. - **Space**: Distance between breasts; narrow or wide. - **Height**: Vertical position of breasts on the avatar. - Mesh size control via Divide Mesh option in property editor: - Mesh size ranges from 1 (coarse) to 3 (fine). - Smaller mesh sizes improve collision handling. - Users can toggle mesh display on or off. --- ## Flattening and 2D Workspace Improvements Describes enhancements to pattern flattening and workspace organization for faster project starts. - Flattened patterns now automatically align to the green line. - Users can immediately begin working in the 2D workspace without additional organization. - Speeds up garment creation time. --- ## Seam Taping Extension Options Details new options for extending seam taping, improving digital realism of garment construction. - Extension options available in the property editor: - **None**: No extension. - **To Outline**: Extends seam tape to the pattern outline. - **To Seam Taping**: Extends to the edge of adjacent seam taping. - These options help the digital garment more closely mimic physical seam taping. --- ## Fabric Creation and Texture Generation Outlines UI improvements and tools for fabric creation, texture application, and color manipulation. - Fabric Creator UI has been improved for easier content creation. - Clo presets remain available for creating realistic fabric textures. - Texture Generator allows importing and creating seamless texture repeats. - Users can preview different texture maps to ensure quality across all channels. - Fabric recoloring options: - **Color Overlay**: Adds a color swatch overlay. - **Desaturation + Color Overlay**: Desaturates fabric then recolors. - **Color Switch**: Replaces one color in the fabric texture, preserving other colors. - Color switch works with any chosen color, providing flexible recoloring. --- ## 3D State Preview and Knitwear Realism Enhancements Covers improvements in 3D state selection and knitwear visual fidelity. - Hovering over 3D states previews them, aiding selection. - Knitwear yarn variance options introduce realistic imperfections: - **Irregularity** controls yarn movement via: - **Scale**: Magnitude of movement. - **Frequency**: How often yarn direction changes. - **Pilling** simulates yarn pulls with controls for: - **Length**: Pull length. - **Thickness**: Yarn thickness. - **Frequency**: Frequency of pulls. - Using both irregularity and pilling together yields the best realism. --- ## Geometry Property Editor Updates Describes new options for geometry and rendering thickness control. - Render thickness moved to the geometry section. - Thickness can be expressed as: - Forward, backward, or both directions. - Face visibility options include front, back, or seam. - Side geometry allows adjusting mesh density on garment sides for finer detail. --- ## Colorway Management Improvements Summarizes enhanced colorway management, addition, and drag-and-drop functionality. - Two methods to add colorways: - **Simple Add Tool**: Quick addition. - **Advanced Add Options**: Includes reminders on functionality. - Improved drag-and-drop for adding colorways and graphics. - Ability to assign colors or graphics to all colorways simultaneously. - Right-click options to revert wrong add choices or hide graphics in other colorways. --- ## Avatar Mesh Control and GPU Simulation Performance Focuses on avatar mesh refinement and simulation speed improvements via GPU. - Mesh size for avatars adjustable to optimize collision handling. - GPU simulation can be activated via the simulation tool: - Click and hold, then switch to GPU simulation. - GPU simulation offers smoother, faster cloth and trim movement. - Supports real-time adjustments during simulation. - Symmetrical edits can be automatically applied to mirrored pattern pieces. - FBX poses or motions can be registered and applied to Clo avatars compatible with GPU simulation. --- ## Rendering Optimization: Mesh Optimization Settings Outlines new rendering options to improve performance and reduce computing load. - Mesh optimization applies only in final renders. - Two new options: - **Frustum Culling**: Excludes mesh outside the camera's view. - **LOD (Level of Detail)**: Reduces mesh complexity based on distance from camera. - Recommended for knitwear rendering to enhance performance. --- ## Panoramic Export for Colorways Introduces a new panoramic export option for rendering colorways. - Available when viewpoint is set to Current View or Custom View (with respective options). - Enables creation of panoramic images from the current camera angle. - Supports

Drag-and-drop functionality simplifies exporting POMs to CSV. --- ## Nesting Algorithm and Colorway Linking Explains improvements to nesting speed, accuracy, and colorway-specific nesting control. - Nesting algorithm speed and accuracy have significantly increased. - Users can select which colorways follow nesting settings: - Options include "Print All" or "Custom" selection of colorways. - New grouping option for graded sizes organizes them into grouped areas along the marker while optimizing layout efficiency. --- ## Avatar Editor: Breast Shape Control and Mesh Size Adjustment Discusses avatar customization features including breast shape controls and mesh refinement for collision management. - Breast shape controls include three parameters: - **Shape**: Round or teardrop breast shapes. - **Space**: Distance between breasts; narrow or wide. - **Height**: Vertical position of breasts on the avatar. - Mesh size control via Divide Mesh option in property editor: - Mesh size ranges from 1 (coarse) to 3 (fine). - Smaller mesh sizes improve collision handling. - Users can toggle mesh display on or off. --- ## Flattening and 2D Workspace Improvements Describes enhancements to pattern flattening and workspace organization for faster project starts. - Flattened patterns now automatically align to the green line.

Extension options available in the property editor: - **None**: No extension. - **To Outline**: Extends seam tape to the pattern outline. - **To Seam Taping**: Extends to the edge of adjacent seam taping. -
